blocks.text: Communication doosron ke saath maloomat, khayalat ya jazbat ke len den (exchange) ka amal hai. Yeh verbal (zabani) ho sakti hai, jaise bolna ya likhna, ya non-verbal (baghair alfaaz ke), jaise ishare (gestures) ya chehre ke taasurat (facial expressions). Achhi communication mein apna paigham saaf saaf pohanchana aur doosron ki baat tawajjo se sunna (active listening) dono shamil hain.
Misal: farz karein aap ka class project mahol ke tahaffuz (environmental conservation) par hai jo aap ko classmates aur teachers ke saamne pesh karna hai. Achhi communication mein yeh shamil hai:

items: Saaf bolna (Clear Speaking): aise bolna ke sab ko aasani se samajh aaye.
Achhi Body Language (jism ki zaban): ishare istemal karna, logon se aankh mila kar baat karna (eye contact) aur aitmaad se khare hona.
Sunna (Listening): sunne walon ke sawalon ke jawab dena aur un ke feedback par ghaur karna.

blocks.prompt: Mahol ke tahaffuz (environmental conservation) par class presentation mein ek verbal aur ek non-verbal skill bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Verbal (zabani): munasib raftar se saaf bolna. Non-verbal (baghair alfaaz): sunne walon se aankh mila kar baat karna (eye contact).

items: Communication: verbal aur non-verbal; saaf bolna, achhi body language, tawajjo se sunna.
